content:
Using the Automated investigation & response card, your security operations team can quickly
navigate to the Action center by selecting the View pending actions link, and then taking
appropriate actions. The card enables your security operations team to more effectively
manage actions that are pending approval.
See the prerequisites for automated investigation and response
Configure automated investigation and response for your organization
Learn more about the Action center
